settings.title: Settings
settings.accountHint: See information about your account, or edit your profile.
settings.displayHint: Manage your background. These settings affect this browser.
settings.languageHint: Manage which language you see across Cradlink.
settings.languagePageHint: Select your preferred language for headlines, buttons, and other text from Cradlink.
settings.notificationsHint: Select the kinds of notifications you get about activities and people.
settings.alertsBody: Get browser alerts for reminders and activity updates. You can change this later in the browser.
settings.deactivateHint: Find out how you can deactivate your account.
settings.deactivateBody: Your profile, activities, and follows will be hidden. You can log in within 30 days to reactivate. After that, the account is closed.
settings.reactivateBody: Your account is deactivated. Reactivate to restore your profile and activities.
settings.closedBody: The 30-day window to reactivate has ended.

auth.name: Name
auth.verifyBody: We asked Firebase to email <email>{{email}}</email>. The sender is usually <sender>{{sender}}</sender>. Check spam and promotions.
auth.verifySmtpHint: If Resend says it was sent and nothing arrives, Firebase’s default mail is being dropped. Set a custom SMTP server in Firebase Console → Authentication → Templates → SMTP settings.
auth.verificationSent: Verification email sent. Check inbox and spam.

feed.title: Home
feed.forYouHint: Based on your skills, place, and who you follow.
feed.emptyBody: Try another filter, or be the one who posts first.

search.title: Search Cradlink
search.hint: Find people or activities — same idea as Explore on X.
search.emptyBody: Try a name, a place, or an activity type.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Follows, joins, replies, and reminders will show up here.

follows.title: Follow requests
follows.unfollowPrivate: Their activities will be hidden until they accept you again.
follows.unfollowPublic: You can follow them again later.
follows.cancelBody: @{{handle}} won’t be notified. You can request again later.
follows.emptyBody: When someone wants to follow your private account, they’ll show up here.

connections.emptyFollowersBodySelf: When someone follows you, they’ll show up here.
connections.emptyFollowingBodySelf: Following accounts is an easy way to curate your feed.

profile.privateAccountHint: Like Instagram: people must send a follow request. Only people you confirm can see your activities.
profile.privateHint: Follow @{{handle}} to see their activities. They’ll have to confirm your request.
profile.noBioSelf: No bio yet. Edit your profile to add one.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, and underscores. This has to be unique.
profile.notFound: No one here by that name.
profile.pastEmptySelf: Finished and cancelled ones will land here.
profile.activeEmptySelf: Create one and it’ll show up here.

mine.title: My activities
mine.emptyJoinedBody: The feed is full of open seats.

activity.privateBody: Follow {{name}} to see it. They’ll have to confirm your request.
activity.removePersonBody: They’ll leave the activity. Their replies stay in the discussion.
activity.joinBody: You’ll show up on the member list. The organizer can see your name.
activity.requestBody: The organizer will accept or decline. You’ll see Requested until they do.
activity.withdrawBody: The organizer won’t see this request anymore.
activity.leaveBody: You can join again later if there is still a spot.
activity.deleteBody: This can’t be undone and it will be removed from your profile, the feed, and search.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What happens, who it’s for, what to bring.
form.linkPlaceholder: Meet link goes out the day before
form.photosHint: Pick a shared default, or your own photo. Up to 6.
form.photosEmpty: None added — we’ll use the shared default for this type.
form.errorTitle: Give it a title (at least 3 characters).
form.errorDescription: Add a short description so people know what they’re joining.
form.errorLookingFor: Add at least one role or skill you’re looking for.
form.errorCity: Add a city for in-person or hybrid activities.
form.errorStart: Pick a start time, or mark it as flexible.
form.errorCapacity: Capacity must be a positive number, or leave it blank.

discussion.title: Discussion
discussion.deleteBody: Replies stay in the thread. People will see that this post was deleted.
discussion.emptyHint: Reply as many times as you want. Replies can have replies.
discussion.startThread: Start the thread — you can post more than once.
discussion.lockPending: You’ll be able to reply once the organizer accepts you.

notFound.title: This page isn’t here.
notFound.body: Check the link, or go back to the feed.

errors.joinToDiscuss: Join this activity to take part in the discussion.
errors.deleteOwnReplies: You can only delete your own replies.
errors.saveReplyRules: Couldn’t save this reply. Publish the latest Firestore rules, then try again.
errors.deleteReplyRules: Couldn’t delete this reply. Publish the latest Firestore rules, then try again.
errors.onlyOrganizerDelete: Only the organizer can delete this.
errors.onlyOrganizerEdit: Only the organizer can edit this.
errors.onlyOrganizerRemove: Only the organizer can remove people.
errors.onlyOrganizerAccept: Only the organizer can accept people.
errors.onlyOrganizerDecline: Only the organizer can decline people.
errors.organizerCantLeave: Organizers can’t leave. Stay, or cancel the activity later.
errors.photosTooLarge: Photos are too large to save in the activity. They need to be uploaded first.
errors.followRules: Couldn’t follow. Publish the latest Firestore rules, then try again.
errors.uploadFailedRules: Could not upload that photo. Check Storage rules for activities/{userId}.
errors.uploadFailedSmaller: Could not upload that photo. Try a smaller image.
errors.usernameTooLong: Username can be at most 30 characters.
errors.usernameInvalid: Usernames can only use letters, numbers, and underscores.
errors.emailInUse: An account with that email already exists.
errors.googleBlocked: The browser blocked the Google popup.
errors.tooManyEmails: Firebase paused confirmation emails. Wait about an hour, then tap Resend once.
errors.unauthorizedDomain: Firebase rejected the confirmation link. Add localhost and 127.0.0.1 under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
errors.waitBeforeResend: Wait a minute before sending another confirmation email.
errors.signInToSendEmail: Sign in first, then we can send the email.
errors.demoGoogleMissing: Demo Google account is missing. Refresh and try again.
